power.method: Rechargeable 4500mAh battery with 1.6W solar panel (5V/1.5A adapter via Type-C)

features: PIR motion events with adjustable sensitivity
white-light colour viewing when an alarm is triggered
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.) and the CG6E model-family manual linked from it. The page states 3MP, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, IP66, two-way audio, PIR events and white-light colour viewing on alarm; the family manual adds 2048x1536 at 15 fps, a 120-degree field of view (axis not stated), microSD up to 128GB, a 4500mAh battery, a 5V/1.5A adapter and a 1.6W solar panel (the page notes the manual should be matched to the camera revision). Typed box from the page's branded CG6E reference image (rectangular battery-camera body on an arm mount). No RTSP/ONVIF is stated (app-only battery camera). Lens, sensor and dimensions are not published.
